avis.texte: I feel for the price point, it's just okay. It doesn't melt into my skin as nicely as other brands I've tried. avis.texte: I love the original scent of this cleansing balm, but I had an allergic reaction on my eyes with this cherry scented one. I used the balm at night to remove my makeup and woke up the next morning with swelling to both my eyelids. I did not have this reaction with the original scent or the rose scent. I do recommend this balm, but not the cherry scent if you have sensitive skin.
